The Glade of Cerelaine

Connects to: 13.03, 17.07, 22.11, 29.07 and 37.01.

Here, in the foothills of the Grey Mountains, is a peaceful glade in which a perfect ring of tall and stately birches grows. This is where the elf Cerelaine retreats to when he tires of the people of the Timberlode (13.03). It is also where he keeps his book of spells and several trinkets under the eyes of watchful water elementals. Category:Hex Category:The Freeholds
